resolution: Two asks. (1) Floor-level placement: pieces ignored the active floor and always landed on the ground because resolveAt fed resolveSnapTarget the level-0 terrain sampler. Added a level-aware placeGroundAt (terrain at level 0, else the flat slab at level*storyHeight) wired into both the click path (resolveAt) and the drag-paint (computePaint), so raising a floor with ▲ snaps placement to that floor. (2) Prefab naming: the ⊞ save button now opens a name prompt (TextInput overlay, defaults to the next 'Custom N', Save/Cancel) and saveSelectionAsPrefab takes the typed name. Committed ad59c4578 (alongside the finished native iso-camera integration the files sit on), bundles clean.
